title: Register for GST
what: Register for GST once the business's GST turnover reaches the registration threshold, then charge GST and lodge activity statements.

triggers.unit: AUD of GST turnover a year
triggers.note: The Act sets $50,000 or a higher amount set by regulation; the regulations set $75,000. Non-profit bodies have their own threshold (s 23-15(2)).

sources.title: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999
sources.quote: Your registration turnover threshold (unless you are a non-profit body) is: (a) $50,000; or (b) such higher amount as the regulations specify.

sources.title: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Regulations 2019
sources.quote: For the purposes of paragraph 23-15(1)(b) of the Act, the amount of $75,000 is specified.

reach.note: Every entity carrying on an enterprise; the threshold decides who must register.

assessment.summary: Businesses with GST turnover of $75,000 or more must register for GST and lodge activity statements.

marks.reason: Registration and activity statements start once turnover reaches $75,000: a step in cost as a business grows.
